work_units.title: Build the independent desktop harness
work_units.notes: The existing optional GNOME X11 focus controller passes 24 native steps for two selected normal windows, modal redirection, closed-target invalidation, workspace changes and a fresh selection; actual F9 receipt confirms the selected/modal target. Observation mode retains all four failed restoration cases. A deliberate helper startup exit calibrates the corrected outer failure result. Forty-five new evidence checks pass. Original optional guards and default behavior remain calibrated. The controller stays disabled by default pending moved-window, broader application/modal, lock/session and alternate-trigger qualification; wallpaper policy, real session-manager and product continuity remain open. Native dconf wallpaper locks now preserve the unchanged solid-color composition; unlocked settings and identical-byte policy replacement fail their intended dimensions. Thirty-five new verifier checks pass. Protected deployment, locked images and live policy/disclosure changes remain unqualified. The owned GNOME surface now independently expires producer leases, retains last accepted public-marker identity/pixels across expiry and native disconnect, and admits replacement pixels only after a full snapshot. The ignored-expiry control fails. Native telemetry/policy, watchdog, automatic restart and editor-exit qualification remain open.

work_units.title: Probe contemporary Windows desktop host
work_units.notes: Read-only native Windows observer now binds the held Explorer process/image/session and two bounded shell/icon hierarchy observations. Fourteen structural tests pass. No pixels, input, attachment or shell restart occurred. Windows 10 VM lab designation/usability remains pending; the package admits only the read-only phase until that boundary is closed. Structural observation does not qualify a host.

work_units.title: Implement demand scheduler and reconciliation
work_units.notes: Authenticated session demand now uses immutable controller-selected requests, actual negotiated roles and authoritative heartbeat/subscription lifetimes. The Linux collector consumes the shared adapter. Full suites pass 130 Linux, 119 Windows and 108 historical-toolset host entries; fifteen historical PE/input audits pass. Original 999 ms native restart failure is retained; implementation now enforces the existing backoff from its reported fault timestamp. General consumer wire selection, invalidation/coalescing, installed policy/controller ownership and the complete five-family 0.1.0 release remain open.

work_units.title: Implement provisional commands and protocol
work_units.notes: The native controller serves coherent saved profiles through authenticated, currently authorized bounded transfers. Its serialized storage owner now supplies exact recovery generations, held directory identities and retention/erase permission. Explicitly negotiated profile transfer 0.2 binds those observations to connection/epoch/profile/editor session, transfer ID and committed revision; the receiver validates the complete closure before exposure. Old 0.1 bytes remain unchanged. Native and portable checks cover exact data, commit/pinned generations, negotiation, scope corruption, provider/join failure, reconnect, denial and current-policy withdrawal. Installed settings/editor and verified helpers have separate W-11/W-26 checkpoints. The W-11 native admission now independently holds directory identities and enforces current-session/storage/result guards, including child-side identity verification before writer creation. Next compose it with the actual frontend live session, exact applied-draft retirement and asynchronous recovery validation before enabling the installed flow. Protected-policy deployment, inspector/telemetry/desktop integration, imports, complete layers/updates, non-Linux adapters and all five full release editions remain required.

work_units.title: Implement scene projection and renderer contracts
work_units.notes: Theme 0.2 now has explicit semantic roles through the Linux scalar, table, chart and conditional-diagnostic composition paths. Independent literal-font pixels, geometry, contrast, scale and erasure checks pass; existing theme pixels and content identities remain. Direct consumers still need explicit experimental_typography plus resource/capability/policy admission. Continue native theme authoring and trusted editor integration, installed ownership, full accessibility/performance, unresolved historical observation causes, other native adapters and all five complete editions. Preserve original failures and contract-based oracle corrections.

work_units.title: Implement direct desktop editor
work_units.notes: Admitted Linux editor recovery now captures atomic edits, offers explicit Restore/Discard/Keep after verified startup, fences matching retirement across Apply and cancellation, and closes/reaps on invalidation. Exact native files, crash/reopen, current policy, scope change and held-helper exit have executable evidence. Continue installed controller/catalog/mandatory-policy and private profile-directory ownership, scene-aligned entry/restoration, native layout/accessibility/performance and all platform editions. Preserve known native diagnostics and blocked historical qualification.

work_units.title: Implement native inspector and settings
work_units.notes: Installed telemetry functional cases pass, but ordinary RECOVERY-GUI-LIMITS failed MAX-WIDGETS delay and MAX-RECORD work against 100 ms. Diagnostic callback/phase attempts passed without reproducing the failure and show limited restore/population headroom. First attribute and repair those costs, then rerun the unchanged ordinary gate. Continue installed image/topology/performance and accessibility, desktop/lifecycle and all five complete release editions. See the source-bound installed telemetry handoff; W-11 is not qualified.

work_units.title: Implement independent recovery and producer leases
work_units.notes: The native network service now composes existing measured acquisition, demand/session, verified installation and independent child supervision for inspector-channel delivery. Native faults and real values pass; the installed frontend telemetry consumer remains next. Real Linux counters/rates now pass measured publication, exact replay, retained injected failure, independent child hang/crash/restart, demand/watch release, typed revocation and parent-loss tests. Shared projection runs on all profiles. Suites: 96 Windows, 101 Linux and 88 historical-toolset host checks. Product controller/demand/policy, real renderer and visible/editor recovery, full network fields, Windows notification coverage, native topology/namespace/suspend faults and retention remain required. The owned GNOME surface now independently expires producer leases, retains last accepted public-marker identity/pixels across expiry and native disconnect, and admits replacement pixels only after a full snapshot. The ignored-expiry control fails. Native telemetry/policy, watchdog, automatic restart and editor-exit qualification remain open. Shared selected measured-network renderer inputs now pass six portable families on all three profiles and real Linux collector comparisons, including explicit stale retention when the peer clock is unavailable. Latest suites: 102 Windows, 107 Linux and 94 historical-toolset host checks. Close native operational delivery, cache ownership and acknowledged policy erasure before enabling those values on the surface. The owned GNOME retained-cache experiment now displays actual C++ projected counters/rates, with independent native glyph decoding, revision/sequence rejection, revocation and observed owner-exit clearing. Wrong-value and ignored-clear controls fail acceptance. Live renderer clocks, product controller policy/demand, general delivery queues and render-watchdog integration remain open. A standalone GJS native clock now preserves exact uint64 strings, authenticated Unix socket provenance and deterministic cleanup. At that standalone checkpoint, shell clock attachment and independently observed displayed age/expiry remained open. The owned GNOME clock fixture now qualifies asynchronous same-session attachment, visible public-sample age/expiry, peer loss and pending-startup disable. Connect actual measured network input and full model status semantics next; retained operational values are not relabeled fresh. The native GJS network consumer now reuses measured DataView/projection and revocable typed policy, with standalone synthetic replay, deadline, age, metadata and cleanup checks. Close live supervised forwarding/teardown and independently qualify operational network pixels next. The finite live session now forwards original real collector frames through the native supervisor to an asynchronous GJS owner. Original values/time/status, held watch/namespace, data-lease loss, worker hang, revocation and parent death are checked independently. Visible operational age/pixels and full recovery remain open. The same asynchronous owner now renders measured values and age in the owned GNOME shell. Nine independently verified cases distinguish freshness from data-lease expiry, enforce policy/native-exit erasure and expose frozen age, false freshness, wrong values and ignored clearing. Independent native supervision now connects health challenges to actual drawing/paint, with external pixels rejecting false progress and retained source/watcher exit failures. Queued late progress, heartbeat and shutdown cannot erase elapsed deadlines. Eight desktop cases and a three-case native deadline experiment define this finite boundary; automatic renderer replacement, current-policy full-state reattachment and complete visible/editor recovery remain open. Native consumer-continuity prerequisite: real collection survives bounded consumer replacement, with original measured full-state reattachment and current typed consumer-policy denial. Visible automatic replacement and editor recovery remain open. The persistent native controller now preserves collection across automatic same-session GNOME shell replacement and original measured-state reattachment. Independent pixels recover after native overview dismissal; disabled attachment fails pixels and typed revocation blocks replacement. Render-stall replacement, editor recovery and installed controller/policy remain open. Independent native render/health guards now drive the persistent shell replacement owner. Eight fixed controls and 33 adversarial evidence checks distinguish drawing stalls, hidden drawing, false progress, frozen shells, prior crash controls and typed revocation. Current original pixels and fresh paint progress recover after native overview dismissal. Editor recovery and installed controller/session/policy/demand ownership remain open. The independent owned-X11 editor lifetime now has nine native keyboard/GTK, frozen/drag/lock, keymap-loss, owner-loss and conflict cases. Held exits, external restored pixels/input and shortcut release are checked separately. The actual desktop/editor role, scene transactions, fullscreen discovery and installed controller/policy ownership remain open. The independent exit owner now restores actual GNOME icon input and original measured pixels without source/controller/shell/icon replacement, including owner loss and a frozen controller. The unavailable-owner control remains a failed candidate. Scene transactions, fullscreen recovery discovery, installed ownership and other platform laboratories remain open. The Linux demand executor checkpoint links W-07 leases to real asynchronous acquisition and confirmed native join; IPC revocation is observed while the source worker remains alive. See SP-DEMAND-EXECUTOR-HANDOFF; installed controller/policy ownership remains open. The session demand adapter now owns authoritative subscription-to-acquisition lifetimes; all three full development suites pass. See SP-SESSION-DEMAND-HANDOFF; installed ownership and scene transactions remain open.

Connect the verified owners through a native worker/UI bridge to the actual editor and inspector next. Complete payload/notices closure, lifecycle, protected-policy deployment and all five release editions remain pending.
